"""Fixed analytical window/taper/carrier-grid calculation; no model quality."""

import argparse, gzip, json, os, shutil, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict
import numpy as np
import psutil
from dense_measurement_support import cases, measure, ratios
from phase_admission_protocol import read, ref, owner_live

R = Path("/home/dllu/proj/demosaic")
ROOT = R / ".cache/quality-20261107/V192-dense-support-v1"


def save(path, value):
    with Path(path).open("x") as f:
        json.dump(value, f, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        f.write("\n")


def dependencies():
    index = R / "docs/results/v191-dense-spectrum-final-v1.json"
    proof = R / "docs/results/v191-dense-spectrum-publication-verification-v1.json"
    completion = R / "docs/results/v191-completed-execution-v1.json"
    p, v, c = read(index), read(proof), read(completion)
    assert (
        v["publication"] == ref(index)
        and v["status"].startswith("pass-")
        and c["status"].startswith("pass-terminal-")
    )
    for o in c["all_terminal_owners"].values():
        assert not owner_live(o)
    for key in ["report", "figures", "notes", "publication_source"]:
        assert ref(p[key]["path"]) == p[key]
    neural = dict(c["previous102_neural_hashes_unchanged"])
    neural["late_dense_local_spectrum.py"] = c["new_neural_source"]["sha256"]
    assert len(neural) == 103
    for name, digest in neural.items():
        assert ref(R / "src/demosaic" / name)["sha256"] == digest
    return {
        "publication": ref(index),
        "verification": ref(proof),
        "completion": ref(completion),
        "neural103_hashes": neural,
    }


def prepare():
    dep = dependencies()
    assert not ROOT.exists()
    assert (
        shutil.disk_usage(R).free > 40.02 * 2**30 and psutil.virtual_memory().available > 32 * 2**30
    )
    log = R / ".cache/v192-support-CPU-tests-v1.log"
    assert "15 passed" in log.read_text()
    ROOT.mkdir()
    work = ROOT / "work/scripts"
    work.mkdir(parents=True)
    files = [
        "report_dense_measurement_support.py",
        "dense_measurement_support.py",
        "dense_support_reference.py",
        "audit_dense_measurement_support.py",
        "phase_admission_protocol.py",
    ]
    for name in files:
        shutil.copyfile(R / "scripts" / name, work / name)
    p = {
        "status": "fixed-analytical-tone-support-and-carrier-quantization-not-quality",
        "created_unix_UTC": time.time(),
        "runner": ref(work / files[0]),
        "auditor": ref(work / files[3]),
        "sources": [dict(ref(work / name), text=(work / name).read_text()) for name in files],
        "dependency": dep,
        "CPU_tests": ref(log),
        "cases": cases(),
        "local_floor_GiB": 40,
        "RAM_floor_GiB": 32,
        "forecast_GiB": 0.020,
        "scope": "V191 changes dense/local representation,taper,coefficientunits andsynthesis together and regresses mesh. Isolate linearmeasurement effects with48fixedanalytic nativefrequencies(12base65gridbins x4subbinoffsets),unit-amplitude cosine/sinequadratures,uniform/graded independentvariance,interior/corner of256packedcontext. Compare rectangular65/global256carriergrid,Hann65/local65grid,Hann129/local129grid. Exact-frequency mode isolates support/taper; nearest-available-carrier mode separately includes deterministic quantization,not inputselection. Both use weightedaffine detrending;signalpower averaged over two quadratures,not randomphase/noise draws. Pure one-phase lattice linearmeasurement,not trainedRGB,fullCFArecovery,confidence orstatisticalreplications. Rectangular256grid is only an available-frequency comparator,not V187actual8binselection. Nearest carrier uses known analytic frequency,not a deployable noisy selector. No realimage,target/reference,checkpoint/model load,oldNN/parent/DINO/RAWdecode,source/noisedraw,original/dataz access orneural-sourcechange. All103sources/earlierreceipts/checkpoints remainunchanged. Newoutputs localforecast.020GiB above40GiBfloor,externalread-only.",
    }
    save(ROOT / "plan-v1.json", p)
    print("Prepared1152deterministiclinear cases;no image/model/noise draws")


def guard(p):
    for b in p["sources"]:
        assert ref(b["path"]) == {k: b[k] for k in ["path", "sha256"]}
    for key, b in p["dependency"].items():
        if key == "neural103_hashes":
            for name, digest in b.items():
                assert ref(R / "src/demosaic" / name)["sha256"] == digest
        else:
            assert ref(b["path"]) == b


def summaries(rows):
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for row in rows:
        groups[tuple(row[k] for k in ["position", "noise", "mode", "method"])].append(
            row["ratio_to_rect65"]
        )
    return [
        dict(
            zip(["position", "noise", "mode", "method"], key, strict=True),
            cases=len(values),
            mean=float(np.mean(values)),
            median=float(np.median(values)),
            minimum=min(values),
            maximum=max(values),
            above_one=sum(v > 1 for v in values),
            below_one=sum(v < 1 for v in values),
        )
        for key, values in groups.items()
    ]


def run():
    p = read(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(p)
    assert ref(__file__) == p["runner"]
    o = {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()}
    for _ in range(60):
        if (ROOT / "launch-v1.json").exists() and read(ROOT / "launch-v1.json")["owner"] == o:
            break
        time.sleep(0.2)
    else:
        raise RuntimeError("Missing actual owner")
    (ROOT / "run.claim").open("x").close()
    os.nice(10)
    os.sched_setaffinity(0, [8, 9])
    start = time.time()
    rows = []
    with gzip.open(ROOT / "measurements-v1.jsonl.gz", "xt", compresslevel=6) as f:
        for case in p["cases"]:
            while (
                shutil.disk_usage(R).free <= 40 * 2**30
                or psutil.virtual_memory().available <= 32 * 2**30
            ):
                time.sleep(5)
            row = measure(case)
            rows.append(row)
            f.write(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    paired = ratios(rows, p["cases"])
    assert len(rows) == 1152 and len(paired) == 768
    result = {
        "status": "completed1152analyticmeasurements-no-image-or-model-quality",
        "owner": o,
        "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
        "measurements": ref(ROOT / "measurements-v1.jsonl.gz"),
        "ratios": paired,
        "summary": summaries(paired),
        "elapsed_seconds": time.time() - start,
        "new_neural_forwards": 0,
        "new_source_noise_draws": 0,
        "scope": p["scope"],
    }
    assert "torch" not in sys.modules and "rawpy" not in sys.modules
    guard(p)
    save(ROOT / "result-v1.json", result)
    print("PASS1152analyticmeasurements/768pairedratios/16summarygroups", flush=True)


def launch():
    p = read(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(p)
    assert not (ROOT / "launch-v1.json").exists()
    env = dict(
        os.environ,
        PYTHONPATH=str(ROOT / "work/scripts"),
        CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="",
        OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",
        OMP_NUM_THREADS="1",
        MKL_NUM_THREADS="1",
    )
    with (ROOT / "run-v1.log").open("xb") as log:
        child = subprocess.Popen(
            [str(R / ".venv/bin/python"), p["runner"]["path"], "run"],
            cwd=R,
            env=env,
            stdout=log,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            start_new_session=True,
        )
    o = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
    save(ROOT / "launch-v1.json", {"owner": o, "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")})
    print(json.dumps(o))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("phase", choices=["prepare", "launch", "run"])
    args = parser.parse_args()
    {"prepare": prepare, "launch": launch, "run": run}[args.phase]()

"""Analytical coherent-tone support and carrier-grid mismatch, not RGB recovery."""

import math

import numpy as np

METHODS = {
    "rect65_grid256": (65, "rect", 256),
    "hann65_grid65": (65, "hann", 65),
    "hann129_grid129": (129, "hann", 129),
}
OFFSETS = [(0.0, 0.0), (0.25, 0.25), (0.5, 0.5), (-0.25, 0.25)]


def target_frequencies():
    k = np.rint(np.fft.fftfreq(65) * 65).astype(int)
    y, x = np.meshgrid(k, k, indexing="ij")
    radius = np.hypot(y, x) / 130
    mask = (
        (radius >= 0.09)
        & (radius <= 0.29)
        & (abs(x) / 130 <= 0.225)
        & (abs(y) / 130 <= 0.225)
        & ((y > 0) | ((y == 0) & (x > 0)))
    )
    bins = np.stack([y[mask], x[mask]], -1)
    bases = bins[np.linspace(0, len(bins) - 1, 12, dtype=int)]
    return [
        {
            "base_bin_yx": [int(y), int(x)],
            "offset_in_65_grid_bins": list(offset),
            "native_fyx": [(float(y) + offset[0]) / 130, (float(x) + offset[1]) / 130],
        }
        for y, x in bases
        for offset in OFFSETS
    ]


def cases():
    return [
        dict(
            id=f"tone{index:02d}-{position}-{noise}-{method}-{mode}",
            target=index,
            frequency=frequency,
            position=position,
            center_yx=[128, 128] if position == "interior" else [0, 0],
            noise=noise,
            method=method,
            mode=mode,
            image_shape=[256, 256],
        )
        for index, frequency in enumerate(target_frequencies())
        for position in ["interior", "corner"]
        for noise in ["uniform", "graded"]
        for method in METHODS
        for mode in ["exact_frequency", "nearest_available_carrier"]
    ]


def geometry(case):
    length, taper, grid = METHODS[case["method"]]
    y, x = np.indices((length, length), dtype=float)
    r = length // 2
    dy, dx = y - r, x - r
    cy, cx = case["center_yx"]
    h, w = case["image_shape"]
    gy, gx = dy + cy, dx + cx
    valid = (gy >= 0) & (gy < h) & (gx >= 0) & (gx < w)
    weight = (
        np.ones((length, length))
        if taper == "rect"
        else np.outer(np.hanning(length), np.hanning(length))
    )
    weight *= valid
    design = np.stack([np.ones_like(x), dx / r, dy / r], -1).reshape(-1, 3)
    noise = (
        np.ones_like(x)
        if case["noise"] == "uniform"
        else 0.7 + 0.2 * gy / (h - 1) + 0.4 * gx / (w - 1)
    )
    target = np.asarray(case["frequency"]["native_fyx"])
    frequency = (
        target if case["mode"] == "exact_frequency" else np.rint(target * 2 * grid) / (2 * grid)
    )
    carrier = np.exp(-4j * np.pi * (frequency[0] * dy + frequency[1] * dx)).ravel() / length
    angle = 4 * np.pi * (target[0] * dy + target[1] * dx)
    return (
        design,
        weight.ravel(),
        noise.ravel(),
        carrier,
        np.cos(angle).ravel(),
        np.sin(angle).ravel(),
        frequency,
    )


def measure(case):
    design, weight, noise, carrier, cosine, sine, frequency = geometry(case)
    gram = design.T @ (weight[:, None] ** 2 * design)
    h = (carrier @ (weight[:, None] * design)) @ np.linalg.inv(gram)
    row = carrier * weight - h @ (design.T * weight**2)
    response = np.array([row @ cosine, row @ sine])
    variance = float((noise * abs(row) ** 2).sum())
    signal = float((abs(response) ** 2).mean())
    snr = signal / variance
    return {
        "id": case["id"],
        "measured_native_fyx": frequency.tolist(),
        "cos_response_real_imag": [float(response[0].real), float(response[0].imag)],
        "sin_response_real_imag": [float(response[1].real), float(response[1].imag)],
        "noise_trace_variance": variance,
        "phase_averaged_signal_power": signal,
        "phase_averaged_signal_to_noise_power": snr,
        "maximum_affine_annihilation_error": float(abs(row @ design).max()),
        "observed_pixels": int(np.count_nonzero(weight)),
        "raw_taper_effective_sample_count_without_affine": float(
            weight.sum() ** 2 / (weight**2).sum()
        ),
    }


def ratios(rows, specifications):
    lookup = {r["id"]: r for r in rows}
    groups = {}
    for case in specifications:
        key = tuple(case[k] for k in ["target", "position", "noise", "mode"])
        groups.setdefault(key, {})[case["method"]] = lookup[case["id"]]
    output = []
    for key, group in groups.items():
        baseline = group["rect65_grid256"]["phase_averaged_signal_to_noise_power"]
        for method in ["hann65_grid65", "hann129_grid129"]:
            output.append(
                dict(
                    zip(["target", "position", "noise", "mode"], key, strict=True),
                    method=method,
                    ratio_to_rect65=group[method]["phase_averaged_signal_to_noise_power"]
                    / baseline,
                )
            )
    return output

"""Independent QR rows and integer-phase synthetic fields for support auditing."""

import numpy as np


def reference(case):
    labels = {
        "rect65_grid256": (65, False, 256),
        "hann65_grid65": (65, True, 65),
        "hann129_grid129": (129, True, 129),
    }
    n, taper, g = labels[case["method"]]
    r = (n - 1) // 2
    cy, cx = case["center_yx"]
    height, width = case["image_shape"]
    y, x = np.mgrid[-r : r + 1, -r : r + 1]
    inside = (y + cy >= 0) & (y + cy < height) & (x + cx >= 0) & (x + cx < width)
    one = np.hanning(n) if taper else np.ones(n)
    window = one[:, None] * one[None, :] * inside
    design = np.stack([np.ones_like(x), x, y], -1).reshape(-1, 3).astype(float)
    q = np.linalg.qr(window.reshape(-1, 1) * design, mode="reduced")[0]
    fy, fx = case["frequency"]["native_fyx"]
    if case["mode"] == "nearest_available_carrier":
        ky, kx = [round(v * 2 * g) for v in [fy, fx]]
        my, mx = ky / (2 * g), kx / (2 * g)
    else:
        my, mx = fy, fx
    dft = np.exp(-2j * np.pi * (my * (2 * y) + mx * (2 * x))).ravel() / n
    row = (dft - (dft @ q) @ q.T) * window.ravel()
    variance = np.ones_like(x, dtype=float)
    if case["noise"] == "graded":
        variance = 0.7 + 0.2 * (y + cy) / (height - 1) + 0.4 * (x + cx) / (width - 1)
    phase = 2 * np.pi * (fy * (2 * y) + fx * (2 * x))
    a = np.sum(row * np.cos(phase).ravel())
    b = np.sum(row * np.sin(phase).ravel())
    noise = float(np.vdot(row, variance.ravel() * row).real)
    signal = float((abs(a) ** 2 + abs(b) ** 2) / 2)
    return {
        "measured_native_fyx": [my, mx],
        "cos_response_real_imag": [float(a.real), float(a.imag)],
        "sin_response_real_imag": [float(b.real), float(b.imag)],
        "noise_trace_variance": noise,
        "phase_averaged_signal_power": signal,
        "phase_averaged_signal_to_noise_power": signal / noise,
        "observed_pixels": int(np.count_nonzero(window)),
        "raw_taper_effective_sample_count_without_affine": float(
            window.sum() ** 2 / (window**2).sum()
        ),
    }

"""Independent QR rows, phase responses and Decimal analytical-support audit."""

import gzip, json, sys, os, time
from collections import defaultdict
from decimal import Decimal, localcontext
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import psutil
from dense_support_reference import reference
from phase_admission_protocol import read, ref, owner_live
from report_dense_measurement_support import ROOT, guard, save


def audit():
    p, r = read(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"), read(ROOT / "result-v1.json")
    guard(p)
    assert ref(__file__) == p["auditor"] and r["plan"] == ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    assert not owner_live(r["owner"]) and r["owner"] == read(ROOT / "launch-v1.json")["owner"]
    assert ref(r["measurements"]["path"]) == r["measurements"]
    os.nice(10)
    os.sched_setaffinity(0, [8, 9])
    with gzip.open(r["measurements"]["path"], "rt") as f:
        rows = [json.loads(line) for line in f]
    assert len(rows) == len(p["cases"]) == 1152
    maxima = {}
    checks = 0
    for case, row in zip(p["cases"], rows, strict=True):
        assert case["id"] == row["id"]
        expected = reference(case)
        for key, value in expected.items():
            observed = np.asarray(row[key])
            value = np.asarray(value)
            error = float(abs(observed - value).max())
            maxima[key] = max(maxima.get(key, 0), error)
            np.testing.assert_allclose(observed, value, rtol=2e-10, atol=2e-10)
            checks += value.size
        assert row["maximum_affine_annihilation_error"] < 1e-11
    lookup = {c["id"]: row for c, row in zip(p["cases"], rows, strict=True)}
    groups = defaultdict(dict)
    for c in p["cases"]:
        groups[tuple(c[k] for k in ["target", "position", "noise", "mode"])][c["method"]] = lookup[
            c["id"]
        ]
    measured = {
        (q["target"], q["position"], q["noise"], q["mode"], q["method"]): q for q in r["ratios"]
    }
    assert len(measured) == 768
    for key, values in groups.items():
        for method in ["hann65_grid65", "hann129_grid129"]:
            expected = (
                values[method]["phase_averaged_signal_to_noise_power"]
                / values["rect65_grid256"]["phase_averaged_signal_to_noise_power"]
            )
            assert measured[*key, method]["ratio_to_rect65"] == expected
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for q in r["ratios"]:
        groups[tuple(q[k] for k in ["position", "noise", "mode", "method"])].append(
            q["ratio_to_rect65"]
        )
    for s in r["summary"]:
        values = groups[tuple(s[k] for k in ["position", "noise", "mode", "method"])]
        assert len(values) == s["cases"] == 48
        with localcontext() as ctx:
            ctx.prec = 50
            mean = float(sum(Decimal(str(v)) for v in values) / len(values))
        assert (
            abs(mean - s["mean"]) < 1e-12
            and s["median"] == float(np.median(values))
            and s["minimum"] == min(values)
            and s["maximum"] == max(values)
        )
        assert s["above_one"] == sum(v > 1 for v in values) and s["below_one"] == sum(
            v < 1 for v in values
        )
    assert len(groups) == 16 and "torch" not in sys.modules and "rawpy" not in sys.modules
    guard(p)
    save(
        ROOT / "verification-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "pass-independent-QR-all1152linearrows-and768ratios-and16Decimalmeans",
            "plan": ref(ROOT / "plan-v1.json"),
            "result": ref(ROOT / "result-v1.json"),
            "source": dict(ref(__file__), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
            "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
            "independent_coordinate_checks": checks,
            "independent_ratios": 768,
            "Decimal_summary_means": 16,
            "maximum_errors": maxima,
            "new_neural_forwards": 0,
            "new_source_noise_draws": 0,
        },
    )
    print("PASS1152independentQRrows/", checks, "coordinates/768ratios/16Decimalmeans", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    audit()
